_comment: Channel messages — the surface that had NO scenarios until a real ping reached him only when he opened his laptop. Every phrasing below is taken from his own Teams activity feed (300 rows, 62 of them @everyone); only the content is anonymised. That distinction is the whole point: the old triage suite was written from imagination and used 1:1 phrasing — 'can you approve the PR' — while his channels speak to the room. 7 of 62 real @everyone asks were being detected. A suite invented rather than sampled cannot find that.

given.subject: everyone pls do update your mid year performance reflection in workday

cases.why: 'pls' is as common as 'please' in his channels and was matched by neither — this exact message reached him only when he opened the screen

given.subject: hi everyone please suggest if we have anything for the sprint demo

cases.why: 'suggest' was missing from the verb list behind 'please' — the list was written for 1:1 review requests

given.subject: everyone can someone confirm whether additional fields were added on the UI

cases.why: 'can someone' is how a room is asked; only 'can you' was matched, which is how one person is asked

given.subject: hi everyone kindly refrain from deploying anything to the uat environment today

cases.why: a constraint on what he may do is an ask — and 'kindly' was matched by nothing at all
short, deadlined, and aimed at everyone including him — the shape most likely to be missed and least forgivable to miss

given.subject: everyone please help in adding the incidents you are working on with the rca

cases.why: work assigned to the room is work assigned to him

given.subject: hi everyone will be away for the rest of the week

cases.why: the other half of the job — widening the ask detector must not turn every announcement into an interruption

given.subject: we have completed the deployment and sanity, all looks good on our side

cases.why: finished work is the most common thing in his channels and needs nothing from him

given.subject: everyone please to inform that the billing sharding changes have been successfully promoted

cases.why: the trap in the other direction: it opens with 'please' and asks for nothing. Matching 'please <anything>' caught this and it had to be narrowed to a verb list.

given.subject: everyone the preprod environment will be down for an hour due to a deployment

cases.why: worth knowing, nothing wanted — the FYI tail is exactly where this belongs
the feed carries these verbatim and they must never reach his phone
